finding.summary: Mojibake was observed in rendered command output, but persisted UTF-8 artifact and page encoding evidence are valid.

evidence.summary: Node UTF-8 read of BrowserObservationArtifact contains valid Cyrillic markers.
Strict mojibake-like markers were not found in persisted observation text.
HTML meta charset, HTTP Content-Type, and Node UTF-8 source read point to UTF-8.

sourceAudit.note: HTTP Content-Type was verified during Phase 20P audit with Invoke-WebRequest: text/html; charset=UTF-8.

proposedChange: Do not change Workspace UI. Keep browser artifact writes as UTF-8 and make future report consumers read/render JSON as UTF-8 before displaying excerpts.
expectedOutcome: Future reports distinguish persisted UTF-8 text from terminal mojibake and avoid false UI repair requests.
rollback: Remove generated Phase 20P repair artifacts; no application behavior was changed.
verificationPlan: Confirm valid Cyrillic markers such as 'Главная' and 'Единая' are present.
Confirm HTTP response remains text/html; charset=UTF-8.
Rerun one approved localhost read-only observation only after explicit approval.
